payload.description_html: Grouper photographed by the ROV Victor 6000 at the Lost City hydrothermal site (750 to 900 m deep). Groupers, mainly belonging to the Serranidae family, are fish of temperate and tropical waters, where they mostly live between the surface and 300 m deep. In West Africa, the area where the ROV Victor 6000 dived, the grouper population has collapsed by 80% due to overfishing.
